answer: Require every new agent to earn its identity through sustained, verifiable work rather than a free signup: it must complete useful tasks checked by independent established peers, whose signed beacon attestations vouch for real output over days, not minutes. A single operator spawning thousands of fake agents would have to pay the full compute, time, and coordination cost for each one, while a lone relic account with no history gains no trust. Like a falcon that must prove it can hunt before joining the flock, an identity that skips this proof stays powerless and earns nothing.
